pages.goal: Scroll down through the home page until the footer is visible, then stop. If a cookie banner appears, choose Reject or Decline. Do not click links, offers, sign-in or purchase buttons.
Open the Video menu in the top navigation and stop when its Features and Models lists are visible. Do not open any item in the menu.
Open the model picker of the image generator and stop when the list of models is visible. Do not generate, upload, sign in or buy anything.
Open the model picker of the video generator and stop when the list of models is visible. Do not generate, upload, sign in or buy anything.
Scroll to the bottom of the audio page, then stop. Do not generate, upload, sign in or buy anything.
Scroll down two screens of the effects gallery, then stop. Do not open an effect, sign in or buy anything.
Scroll down two screens of the community feed, then stop. Do not open a post, sign in or buy anything.
Switch the billing period between monthly and annual once, then scroll to the end of the page and stop. Do not click any plan, upgrade or purchase button.
Select the Claude Code tab, scroll down one screen to the presets list, then stop. Do not copy, install or sign in.
